# Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max

By **[Lukianenko Vasyl / 3DGROUND](https://3dground.net)** · Version **1.2.0** · Other

Develop Python and Qt tools for 3ds Max from verified starter templates: MaxScript launcher, safe restart, frameless window with rounded corners and a collapsed bar that follows Max, themed shared controls, Settings / Logs / About / Donate, an API for MAXScript and AI assistants, interface size for 2K and 4K screens, crash-safe start, layered testing and official MaxPkg MZP delivery.

## How to use

1. Import this standalone community/custom skill ZIP in a compatible Max Ultra MCP build, then start a new AI chat. It is separate from the product's built-in skills; importing it does not install or run a Python tool.
2. Ask for Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max. Supply the tool's purpose or existing code, target Max releases, intended scene effects, project destination, the developer name and links to show in About, and a donation link if you want Donate buttons \(without one there are none\); the assistant then asks which donation offers you want.
3. New tools start from the included starter templates: one page per module with the full source, renamed to your tool. You get the frameless window with its own title bar, round window buttons, a dark header shade and rounded corners, the same chrome on every dialog, the compact collapsed bar that docks in the active viewport and follows the Max window, the status bar with View Logs, Settings, About and Donate, and a controls trainer that shows the whole catalog in one design: fields of one height with red required stars, instant checks and an error bubble, help balloons, collapsible groups, switches, check boxes, steppers, a calendar with months, years and an optional time, a time field, a badge dropdown, dropdowns with icons, groups, typing and check boxes, choice cards, a scene tree, a drop zone, stat tiles with column, line and donut charts, spinners, skeleton rows, a progress ring, wizard steps, lying and standing sliders with one or two handles, count and status badges, tags, filter pills, search with suggestions, a multi-select list, a pick button for scene objects, plain and rotating links, a list editor, cards, a gallery with a lightbox, a colour picker with a screen pipette, a busy overlay, result cards, empty states, soft edges on scrolling areas, rounded menus with keys and a red Delete, one spacing scale for every margin and gap, the tool's own rounded tooltips, narrow Command Panel-style windows by default, an API for MAXScript, Python and AI assistants in every tool, collapsed bars of several tools in one row at the viewport corner, pills, progress, toasts, the tool's own questions, messages and prompts, a welcome window and a mini log of statuses, with a guide to choosing the right control. Settings come as tabs or as a list on the left, buttons of a dialog's bottom row are one size, and donations are offered only where you choose \(status bar, About, after a success, a start reminder\). Also optional self-update, daily logs with a modeless Logs window, thin pill scroll bars, seven editable themes with Warm Graphite as default, and interface size for 2K and 4K screens.
4. The templates also carry the Max lessons: a start guard that reports a crash at start in the Listener \(and so in MaxPkg's log\) and starts in safe mode, the garbage-collector hold for 3ds Max 2024, screens looked up by position, background jobs with a GIL pump, heavy work in a child process. Specify your preference for responsive breakpoint adaptation; the assistant asks before enabling it.
5. For real-Max verification, provide an authorized isolated or synthetic Max fixture connected through Max Ultra MCP. Request the interface harness that runs inside each available Max \(PySide2 and PySide6\) with the windows off screen, plus unit, regression and visual checks. Unavailable hosts and unrun scenarios must remain explicitly untested.
6. Creating a tool includes a package-ready source project and a local installable MZP built by the official MaxPkg Packager through its API in a selected Max instance. Build and archive checks are separate from authorized install/update/uninstall tests. Narrow edits/audits stay scoped; external publication and push require separate authorization.

Example requests:

- Use Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max to build a scene report tool for Max 2022 to 2027 from the starter templates. Developer: Jane Doe, link janedoe.example. No donation link. Do not modify scene objects. Deliver the source project and an MZP built with the official MaxPkg Packager.
- Move this existing Python Qt tool onto the starter's tool window: own title bar, collapse to the bar that follows Max, Settings with theme and interface size, Logs and About in the status bar.
- Apply the controls catalog to this tool: one control height, required stars and error bubbles, switches instead of check boxes for options, a version stepper and a date picker, collapsible optional groups, help balloons with short blocks, a mini log that shows statuses only, and the daily Logs window; make it readable on a 4K screen.
- Give this free tool a polite donation story: Donate in the status bar and About opening a Support window in my words, a donation line after a successful export, and a reminder on the fifth start with I've already donated, don't remind me. My donation page is https://example.com/donate.
- Show me the controls trainer inside 3ds Max, then build my tool's Settings as a list on the left with General, Appearance, Updates, Support and Reset.
- My tool crashes 3ds Max 2024 at start for some users. Add the start guard, the Listener report and the garbage-collector hold, and tell me what to ask the users for.
- Design isolated tests for this tool's theme switching, repeated launch, collapsed bar following Max, interface size at 125 and 150 percent and 200%+ DPI, using Max's own Python outside Max and available disposable Max instances through MCP.

Expected output: For tool creation: a maintainable source project built from the starter templates with a .ms entry point, safe restart, the standard window and controls, Settings / Logs / About \(and Donate when a destination is given\), themes, interface size, crash-safe start, documentation, layered test evidence, and a locally built official MaxPkg MZP with archive verification; if blocked, the fullest verified ready-to-build project and explicit missing prerequisites. Narrow refactors/audits stay scoped. Includes nineteen template pages, seven verified palettes and fifty-one reference screenshots. The templates are verified source to adapt, not a pixel-identical guarantee; no practical Max testing of this skill is claimed.

## Dependencies

- A coding-capable AI client and filesystem access to the tool project; the reference product checkouts are not required after importing this skill.
- For generated tools: Autodesk 3ds Max with its bundled Python, pymxs, qtmax and matching PySide/Qt family \(PySide2 for 2022-2024, PySide6 for 2025-2027\). Inspect actual target versions and capabilities.
- For host verification: Max Ultra MCP connected to an authorized isolated/synthetic Max instance. The standalone harness uses the Python that ships with each installed Max outside Max.
- For default local MZP delivery: current official maxpkg-dev/max-dev-tool guidance and original packager/hooks, required project metadata and icon/licenses, and a selected suitable 3ds Max connection exposing MaxPkgPackerApi through Max Ultra MCP. No custom ZIP-to-MZP substitute is permitted.
- Generated tools need original Lucide SVG icons and their ISC license \(the starter lists the icons it uses\) and the tool's own brand icon. Icons are not bundled in this instruction-only skill.
- A Max Ultra MCP custom-skill importer supporting the optional skill.json display manifest. This package contains instructions, Markdown template pages with source code to copy, JSON palette references and PNG reference images; no executable helpers.

## Verification

Level: **package-validated**. Package validation runs independently of practical testing.

Catalog importer-contract validation, generated pages, the repository test suite, catalog check and a deterministic ZIP build passed for 1.1.0, 1.1.1 and 1.2.0. For 1.2.0 the starter was regenerated from the template pages \(identical to the tested project\), compiled with Python 3.7.9 and 3.13.9, and run as one project inside 3ds Max 2022 \(PySide2 5.15.1\) and 3ds Max 2027 \(PySide6 6.8.3\) through Max Ultra MCP with its windows off screen, settings in a scratch folder and empty scenes, at 125 % interface size: 235 scripted checks passed in each \(the API: describe, refusals, a dry run, MAXScript MyToolAPI.call and loading without a window; the tool's own rounded tooltips; the collapsed bars' shared row; the spacing scale read from every layout call and style sheet padding, the calendar's months, years, keys, range and time, menus with keys and the red Delete fill in pixels, dropdowns with icons, groups, typing and check boxes, choice cards, the scene tree, the drop zone's states, chart ticks and hover values, spinners and the busy button, control heights and footer widths, the wheel never changing a field or a slider, masked popups outlined on every side, fonts in every window and after a theme change, View Logs, required fields and the error bubble with a faked pointer, toasts, questions, messages, collapsible groups, the badge dropdown, the collapsed bar, Settings as tabs and as a list, About, Welcome, Support, the Logs window, the mini log, a background job with the result card, the light system shadow of the error bubble and help balloon \(native window class\), the tooltip outline, the collapsed bar's sizes, the trainer's sliders, colour picker with its screen pipette, gallery and lightbox, dialogs centred over their window, the multi-select list, the pick button with a stand-in for Max's pick mode, links and the rotating link, standing sliders, size grips, icons and dots aligned in pixels, the veil going with its dialog, badges, filter pills, search, list editor, cards, gallery, busy overlay, empty states and soft edges, the donation rules, and self-update from a file:/// release with rollback and a checksum refusal\). A native crash in Max 2022 \(a completer owned by its line edit\) and a PySide6-only event-filter failure in Max 2027 were found by these runs and fixed. The trainer was also started on screen in 3ds Max 2027 through its launcher several times \(clean restart, start guard ready\). The reference images come from the 3ds Max 2022 run. Earlier parts were host-tested in 3ds Max 2022 and 2027 as TerraScoop. Native window effects were not exercised, and no practical skill test or reviewer is recorded.
